summary: This code creates a list of metadata describing API endpoint categories and passes it to FastAPI to organize endpoints in the API documentation. Each category has a name and description that will appear in the auto-generated API docs.

explanations.3: This declares a variable that holds a list of dictionaries; each dictionary must have string keys and string values, which is what list[dict[str, str]] means.
explanations.16: The openapi_tags parameter tells FastAPI to use our metadata list to group and label endpoints in the auto-generated OpenAPI documentation (the interactive API docs).
